findings.reason: the section's own change to the answer predicate would ship unmeasured, and the retry symptom §1 records, an ask answered from the wrong fact, returns as its mirror image, an ask that never answers True.
findings.text: §3's five cases measure the guard's refusals and the two request writes, but no case asserts `_ask_session_host_for_follower` returns True when the calling host's census names a live child; case 2 asserts only that a request is written, so a predicate returning False unconditionally satisfies all five cases while the function reports False on every dispatch ask

findings.reason: a worker reading "a re-arm" inside §3's write scope, which contains `_rearm_session_follower`, cannot tell that the dispatch path is the one affected, and no case measures that path.
findings.text: the sentence attributing the census read to "a re-arm" points at the wrong caller: `_rearm_session_follower` already asks its host's census (dispatch_watch.py:810-812) and needs no change, while the production effect of the change sits in `_arrange_dispatch_follower` (dispatch.py:398), which sets `session_delivery = "host"` from that return and is not named
